content.short: Story is a Layer 1 blockchain that turns intellectual property into a programmable asset with onchain licensing and royalties.
content.description: Story is a purpose built Layer 1 blockchain that treats intellectual property as a programmable asset class. Built with the Cosmos SDK and EVM equivalent at the execution layer, it stores graph shaped data natively so derivative works, remixes, and licence chains can be represented directly rather than flattened into token balances. Its Proof of Creativity protocol is enshrined in the chain itself, powering permissionless licensing and automatic royalty distribution back through a work's lineage as AI models and applications consume that IP.
content.meta: Story is a Layer 1 blockchain for programmable IP, with onchain licensing and automated royalties. Discover Story on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
